title: Koperasi: pay from the co-op's Ethereum address
description: The co-op's Ethereum address (0xb3dc0128b4a9804de94796480bef8ba014dfca7d on Sepolia) has no private key: NEAR's MPC network signs for it only when the DAO calls `sign`, which it does only by this vote. Get both fields from the page's "Pay on Ethereum" form (it reads the nonce and gas from Sepolia): the transaction's fields, and the hash they make. The page checks that the hash is the transaction's before you vote, and sends the signed transaction once the vote passes.
